rdfs:label: broader
rdfs:comment: A broader (parent) SKOS Concept in a hierarchy — "category-theory broader algebra".
notes: The hierarchical-up relation in a SKOS taxonomy. Inverse of `urn:solid:narrower`. `skos:broader` is NOT transitive; for ancestor chains SKOS defines the transitive superproperty `skos:broaderTransitive` (http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#broaderTransitive). By convention `broader` links concepts within the same scheme; for cross-scheme links use `urn:solid:broadMatch`. For non-hierarchical relatedness, use `urn:solid:related`.

history.note: Corrected transitivity claim (broader is never transitive; see broaderTransitive); added broadMatch to seeAlso/notToBeConfusedWith.
